mapper.update:
UPDATE draw_order SET fulfillment_event_status = #{fulfillmentEventStatus}, update_time = now() WHERE u_id = #{uId} AND order_id = #{orderId}
AND ((#{fulfillmentEventStatus} = 1 AND award_fulfillment_status = 1 AND fulfillment_event_status IN (0, 2, 3))
OR (#{fulfillmentEventStatus} = 3 AND fulfillment_event_status IN (0, 2))
OR (#{fulfillmentEventStatus} = 2 AND fulfillment_event_status = 0))

UPDATE draw_order SET stock_settlement_event_status = #{stockSettlementEventStatus}, update_time = now() WHERE u_id = #{uId} AND order_id = #{orderId}
AND ((#{stockSettlementEventStatus} = 1 AND stock_settlement_event_status IN (0, 2, 3, 4))
OR (#{stockSettlementEventStatus} = 3 AND stock_settlement_event_status IN (0, 2))
OR (#{stockSettlementEventStatus} = 2 AND stock_settlement_event_status = 0))
